race.comment: DAILY REWARD (12) hasn't raced since finishing seventh in the G3 Maribyrnong Plate at Flemington and has placed in two trials leading into return. This is naturally much easier and she should prove very hard to beat. PULL MY FINGER (2) has recorded 11 minor placings from 14 starts to date, the latest when third over 1000m at this track. Knocking on the door and has fitness/experience on his side. Can break through. TOUS (11) was out of the money on debut two runs back then wasn't far away in fifth when last seen at Pakenham Synthetic. Tough draw but hard to hold out. LADY IN RED (8) is going okay and has claims on the minor placing here last time.
